items.title: Sam Kininger interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 27, 2011
items.q: I was listening to Trane and Bags, you know, with Milt Hinton and the vibe record.

ctx.x: Yeah. I mean I like his early bebop stages, and that’s the part about him — I like that he transitioned through so many different phases. And I know a lot of people like in the end, you know, he kind of went to outer space, you know, and it’s kind of how he went out. He had like played through every phase in the music and he just took off. I mean I was — just yesterday I was listening to Trane and Bags, you know, with Milt Hinton and the vibe record.
